purpose: Honest control-impact baseline. This is a starting evidence deficit, not a quality score and not a target denominator.

threeValuedImpact.law: EXACT = the name is a capability-declared derivedChannel present in the census. INFERRED = reachable from an EXACT seed across authored var() edges. UNKNOWN = neither.
threeValuedImpact.computedOver: the operational corpus only (status active | app-slot | adjudicated-live), never the full 7470-name universe

driftCheck.note: customization-surface-report.json currently reports a STALE input digest because 161 files are uncommitted in the inherited worktree. A read-only rebuild produced identical aggregate counts (universe 7470, writers 4811, publicHooks 93, deadWriters 270, unclassified 0), so the classification numbers are live-true; only the byte digest has drifted. Re-check once the concurrent lanes commit.

layoutReachDefectClosedInR0.defect: The impact map's Layout/measure impact column mischaracterized layout-affecting reach.
layoutReachDefectClosedInR0.rootCause: The column was a regular expression matched against the CONTROL ID string (/density|typography\.scale|shape\.radius|responsive/), not an analysis of the properties its channels actually reach. Every control whose id missed those four substrings was reported paint-only.
layoutReachDefectClosedInR0.fix: The column is now derived from the authored-CSS walk: each --ds-* name records the non-custom CSS properties that read it, and a control is layout-affecting when any of its EXACT or INFERRED channels is read by a box-model, track or text-measurement property. The published column now names the properties, so the claim is falsifiable.

controlCatalogDriftCheck.vocabularyVersusBudgetLaw: 294 is the vocabulary size and 200 is the per-document budget. They are structurally distinct mechanisms (allowlist membership versus entry count) and must never be reconciled by widening the cap.
